desc: A large imposing Backrooms entity wolf creature filling the frame: body of shadow with rusted pipes and torn wallpaper cape, a crown of fluorescent tubes as solid pale bars, long jaw, pale hollow eyes, ornate gold-yellow armor trim, the most powerful and majestic design. Pixel art game pet sprite, chibi 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, clean flat shading with 2-3 tones, small dark eyes with white highlight, no glow, no sparkles, no particles, no ground shadow.
